reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay and uses monthUtils.dayFromDate; every holiday consumer already routes through it.

duplication.why: A single added comparison in the one shared predicate; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay, the single definition of a non-working day.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, commented change in the canonical function; the format distinction is obvious and tested.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks (schedules/app.ts, shared/schedules.ts, getDateWithSkippedWeekend) go through isNonWorkingDay.
